testCase.name: ProGuard Rule Missing
testCase.description: Runtime crash in release build due to obfuscation

metadata.context: Gson reflection methods removed by R8

expectedFix.explanation: Add ProGuard keep rule for serialization classes

agent_response.rootCause: ProGuard in build.gradle.kts line 28 (minifyEnabled=true) removes method getUserName() from User class at User.kt line 45, causing NoSuchMethodError at runtime in MainActivity.kt line 102. Additionally, ProGuard is removing virtual methods like hashCode() and equals() from other classes such as JsonObject.kt and JsonArray.kt.
fixGuidelines: Edit proguard-rules.pro to preserve virtual methods used by Gson reflection deserialization.
Disable minification for debug builds in build.gradle.kts line 28: buildTypes { debug { isMinifyEnabled = false } release { isMinifyEnabled = true } }
Verify that the User class's getUserName() method and other relevant virtual methods are preserved after applying the fix by running ./gradlew assembleRelease and checking the usage.txt file.
